title: Coordinate Input
summary: Reads coordinates in any common format and catches swapped or sign-flipped values, so a pin doesn't land on the wrong continent.
description: Reads decimal, DMS and pasted map links (taking Google's pin, not the map centre), catches swapped latitude and longitude, flipped west/south signs against an expected area and 0, 0 defaults, and reads each point back with an OpenStreetMap link.
catches: West or south signs flipped, compared with the expected area
Map links pasted in, using the pin rather than the map centre
DMS and decimal formats, read back as one point
limits: Sign and swap checks need an expectedArea to compare against
Assumes WGS 84 latitude/longitude; projected coordinates are not supported
The OpenStreetMap link opens an external site
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" status
Icons are aria-hidden; the point is read back in text
stops: Pin lands on the wrong continent
